reviews.text: Dominion Crossing and Dr. Guess are wonderful with our fur babies. They are so gentle and caring, while being thorough in our sweet babies care. Our 15 year old American Eskimo has been going to DC for years and is completely calm during visits. Our newest rescue was extremely nervous on her first visit but they were so patient with her. We highly recommend Dominion Crossing.
Such an amazing clinic! Clean, friendly, so sweet to my little cat, fast, and efficient! Highly recommend Dr. Padget & Dr. Shaw as well!
I’m very pleased with Dr. Shaw! She thoroughly explained the treatment plan and made me feel comfortable that we were doing the best we could for our puppies.

Staff is so very helpful and compassionate.  Dr Shaw is super helpful and never conducts unnecessary test.

4/27/2026 - Once again,  Dr Shaw and team did a stellar job on my Brodix boy.  They were able to find out what was causing his discomfort and sent us home with a treatment.

9/15/2026 - I can't thank Dr Shaw and staff for helping my Brodix boy yet again. The expertise and compassion on helping him with his eye issue has helped with his healing.

We had a wonderful experience bringing our grand-dog, Enzo, in. From the moment we walked through the door, everyone treated us so kindly and made us feel welcome. The team answered all of my questions, and the veterinarian was very knowledgeable, caring, and thorough. We truly appreciated the fantastic care Enzo received. Highly recommend!
Been bringing our pets here for a few years now and would recommend. They are great with our pets and are very transparent with care needed and the options we have.

Great experience! Everyone was kind, caring and professional, and they took such good care of our pet. The vet was very thorough and took the time to answer all of our questions. Definitely recommend!

I recommend Dominion Crossing Vet to anyone looking for a good and trustworthy vet. Gibby has been coming here since he was a puppy and always has the best care. My wife and I absolutely trust this vet with our pug.
The annual checkups are thorough which I love. Their services are offered but not pushed.  I feel like they are genuinely interested in the pet's health.

So easy to book a quick check on our dog who was suddenly yelping when running or jumping. They thorough examined & x-rayed, determined appropriate treatment, and he is back to normal after 3 days. Much appreciate their follow up also to ensure he is OK. Thanks so much!
Always good services provided for my dog, each and every visit.

Dr Shaw is a very caring and knowledgeable vet.
Her staff is caring and helpful. I’m grateful that our Blanca has such a great team caring for her.
Thank you!
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.

Best place in the city! Especially for doggy dental work! Dr. Armstrong is absolutely amazing. She is so passionate about what she says and does. Her work really shows! The overall experience was like no other. Spent at least 15 minutes explaining the procedure to me and made 100% sure my dog was ready and healthy for his procedure. Answered all of my questions. Explained why they did what they did during the procedure when we picked our dog up and showed us the x-rays, etc. They even offer to keep your dog there to recover until they close! They follow up asking about how your dog is doing post-procedure. Really really amazing experience all around. Trust them completely and feel comfortable with their care. Will be back with our other dogs! A+++++++!
Friendly and professional
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us. We hope sweet Pepper is doing well!

I’ve been going to Dominion Crossing since 2019, originally with my family’s dogs Bentley and Porter, and now with my own 4 fur babies (Atlas, Ruby, Crow, & Umber). I’m a huge animal lover and try to be really well versed in veterinary care so that my pets get the best care possible. Dr. Shaw and the whole team have been nothing but the absolute best to work with and have helped with Atlas’ many a problem. He has had three surgeries (neuter, lump removal, cancer removal), multiple biopsies, a multitude of issues with a cough, and finally excessive itchiness that needed intervention. The other three animals miraculously have no issues 🫠. They have helped us through each problem and been very informative of different treatment options and very transparent with pricing. They’ve also been so helpful dealing with our pet insurance! I’m breathing fine now because less than 24 hours after his first Cytopoint injection and he is itch free 🥺❤️🐾 thank you!!

I needed a new vet and I’m so glad I found them. Everyone is so thoughtful, kind, and knowledgeable. I have a senior English bulldog so having a good vet is extremely important to me. Dr.Armstrong clearly is passionate about the care she provides. She helped my girl improve her itchiness tremendously after years of allergy issues! Highly recommend!

Domination Crossing provided caring service to our cat's injured paw. They were transparent with the cost prior to treatment methods, which brought more ease. We were pleased with the outcome. Our Willow has healed nicely. Much appreciation!

BEST VET EXPERIENCE — AMAZING FOR DENTAL ISSUES
If I could give Dominion Crossing Veterinary Hospital a million stars, I would. Dr. Armstrong is an incredible veterinarian who specializes in dental issues and tooth extractions, and I truly cannot say enough good things about her and her team. This place genuinely answered our prayers, and I could not be more grateful.

I live in Chicago with my 12.5-year-old dachshund, but I’m originally from San Antonio. He began having nosebleeds, and two different vets in Chicago immediately told us he likely had cancer — without doing any testing first. We were sent on a stressful and expensive chase trying to schedule diagnostic imaging, and were even given a euthanasia quality-of-life packet because we did not have enough money to immediately pursue possible radiation treatment.

I brought my dog home to Texas and scheduled an appointment with Dr. Armstrong. To my surprise, there are really only a couple of vets in the city who specialize in dentistry and dental-related issues, Dr. Armstrong being one of them. From the moment we arrived, the experience was incredible. Great availability, no long waits, an amazing staff, and Dr. Armstrong herself is truly out of this world. She takes the time to thoroughly explain what is going on, educate pet owners, and walk through her clinical reasoning in a way that is thoughtful, logical, and compassionate. She explained that they could perform labs and x-rays in-house that same day at a very reasonable price, instead of sending us all over the place for testing. Based on how severe my dog’s dental disease was, she believed his symptoms (nosebleeds) were actually related to his teeth — and the lab work and x-rays later confirmed that suspicion.

We were able to get him scheduled for surgery just TWO days later, which was incredible given how urgent and emotional the situation felt. Her team took amazing care of him throughout the process and gave us consistent updates during surgery.
Most importantly, Dr. Armstrong was able to confirm that my dog did NOT have a tumor in his nasal cavity. Instead, he had fistulas between infected teeth and his nasal cavity, which she repaired during surgery.

I genuinely believe this experience was somewhat of a miracle. Dr. Armstrong and her amazing team not only improved my dog’s quality of life, but very possibly saved it in more ways than one. He is now back to being a happy boy and I hope my family can continue to enjoy him for more years to come. There truly are no words to describe how grateful I am. Overall, this is an incredible veterinary hospital, and I cannot recommend it enough. Dr. Armstrong genuinely cares about the pets she treats, and I know my dog is in the absolute best hands with Dominion Crossing Veterinary Hospital.
